annotations.title: Email a client their portal link again

description: Emails a client their portal invite again, same link, from the firm. Refuses test leads, submitted portals, or a send in the last 24 hours. Does not CC anyone. A first call returns a preview; a second call with confirm true and that preview_id applies the change. Sign-in required.

confirm.description: false or omitted returns a preview; true applies the change identified by preview_id.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. A retry with the same key returns the first result without a second write. Defaults to preview_id.

preview_id.description: preview_id is the id returned by this tool's preview call. Required when confirm is true.

name: resend_portal_link
